subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A group of engineers shared free designs for a low-cost wheelchair part online.”?
options: People in different countries downloaded the design, improved it, and adapted it to local materials.
Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.
Many people can see copies, but ownership and originality still matter in different ways.
The engineer explained that earlier cities used different materials and methods to move water.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「People in different countries downloaded the design, improved it, and adapted it to local materials.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Many people can see copies, but ownership and originality still matter in different ways.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The engineer explained that earlier cities used different materials and methods to move water.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「People in different countries downloaded the design, improved it, and adapted it to local materials.」，答案為「People in different countries downloaded the design, improved it, and adapted it to local materials.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「People in different countries downloaded the design, improved it, and adapted it to local materials.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
